sentences.en: The task assigned to him was to do marketing research.
sentences.zh: 他被指派的任务是做市场调研。

sentences.en: I have to assign more men to that work.
sentences.zh: 我必须给那项工作分配更多的人手。

sentences.en: He is sure to carry out the task assigned to him.
sentences.zh: 他一定会完成交给他的任务。

senses.zh: 分配；指派；[计][数] 赋值
将财产过户（尤指过户给债权人）

mnemonic: 词根记忆：as（加强）+sign（信号）→一再给人信号→指定
